newsitem.title: ITALY: Two Berisha children flee Albania-ferry official.
newsitem.headline: Two Berisha children flee Albania-ferry official.

text.p: Two children of Albanian President Sali Berisha fled the troubled Balkan state by sea on Thursday, said an official for the shipping line that brought them to Italy.

Domenico Stea told Reuters by telephone from the southern port of Bari that the two children, a man and a woman in their twenties, had diplomatic passports and had been accompanied on the ferry Palladio by five armed guards.
Stea, agent in Bari for the Adriatica line which owns the Palladio, said the Berisha children were met at the port by friends or relatives after disembarking and were driven away.
The five guards, who boarded the Palladio with their charges in the Albanian port of Durres, had handed their weapons over to the ship's captain, Stea said.

The guards and 11 other Albanians without visas or proper documents were kept on board the Palladio after its other 60 passengers, including Italian, Belgian, Danish and Albanian citizens, were allowed off following police checks, Stea said.
He was unable to give the Berisha children's first names but said he had seen them on board and that their surnames were on the passenger list. "This is reliable information," he said.
